docs.text: Members of Hanlan Boat Club in Toronto made 3 C-R boxes for our indoor winter training space this fall. We decorated one box to look like a body of water with rowers rowing in winter. We don’t actually row on Lake Ontario in winter but the little people are tougher than us! With .bsky.social

#OTD 30/11/1940 #RememberRCN -HMCS NAPANEE departs Kingston Shipyards to avoid winter freeze on Great Lakes, for completion in Montreal. In a blinding snowstorm, corvette grounds at Morrisburg Canal & returns to Kingston for repairs, delaying its commissioning until 1941.

Boatswaines aboard the HMCS Margaret Brooke ensure the ship's secure while transiting through vsarious Locks sailing the Great Lakes. Image was captured on September 17, 2025. Photo: Canadian Armed Forces Imagery Technician. #RCN #Photos #History

#OTD 14/5/1942 #RememberRCN -First St Lawrence convoy departs Sydney, CB. to Bic Island, escorted by HMCShips KENOGAMI & ARROWHEAD. SQS-1 consisted of 21 Merchant ships proceeding on to Quebec City, Montreal and ports along the St. Lawrence River and Great Lakes.

#OTD 24/10/1991 #RememberRCN -HMCS OKANAGAN departs Halifax for the Great Lakes & is first RCN submarine to enter the Great Lakes with stops at Quebec City, Montreal, Prescott, Hamilton, Toronto, Oshawa & Kingston before returning to Halifax on 30 November. Photo -Julie Ferguson

The 1st lines are secured as HMCS KINGSTON arrives at her Namesake city of Kingston, Ontario on 12 July 2013.The MCDV is on a Great Lakes tour and the shore party are from the local Naval Reserve unit, HMCS CATARAQUI. #RCNavy Photo Collection. See MORE zurl.co/lBEmW

#OTD 21/12/1870 #RememberRCN -The Royal Navy base at Kingston, ON. is the 1st naval base transferred to Canada, located on Point Frederick on Navy Bay. On the condition the facilities & dockyard continue to be used for naval purposes on the Great Lakes. The site became the Royal Military College.

Out for a walk last night on the #Halifax waterfront & ran into an old friend, HMCS MARGARET BROOKE. I have been in the ship for several events & day sail on Lake Ontario. A highly capable ship with an incredible ships company. NOTE: In the 2nd pic that is lens glare, not a #UFO over the harbour!
HMCS HARRY DEWOLF approaches the Welland Canal Channel at Port Weller from Lake Ontario on 22 October 2024. #RCNavy Photo Collection. See MORE zurl.co/WJiRR

#OTD 22/10/2025 #RememberRCN - HMCS HARRY DEWOLF is the first Arctic & Offshore Patrol Ship to transit the Welland Canal from Lake Ontario to Lake Erie during its Great Lakes Deployment. See more photos from this transit. zurl.co/V8LVZ

#OTD 16/10/1954 #RememberRCN -HMCS QUINTE (2nd) experiences its first severe weather as the newly commissioned Bay class minesweeper passes through Hurricane Hazel (Cat 1) while transiting the Great Lakes after commissioning in Thunder Bay, ON.

#OTD 11/8/1938 #RememberRCN -A Royal Canadian Navy Volunteer Reserve (RCNVR) Half Company is raised in London, Ontario. In 1941 it is named HMCS PREVOST, after HMS LADY PREVOST a 12 gun schooner that took part in the 1813 Battle of Lake Erie. HMCS Prevost / NCSM Prevost

#OTD 10/4/1923 #RememberRCN -Royal Canadian Naval Volunteer Reserve Half Company is formed in Toronto, ON. Renamed HMCS YORK in 1941, after an early commercial vessel that sailed on Lake Ontario, a 66 ton schooner built in the Niagara River in 1792. HMCS York / NCSM York

Arriving HMCS MARGARET BROOKE via ships MRRIB (Multi-Role Rigid Inflatable Boat) from HMCS CATARAQUI in Kingston,ON. Due to weather, sail to Brockville with the ship was canceled in exchange for tour,10 O’clock soup & sail on Lake Ontario. More to follow.
